change_proposals.design: Keep Google for identity; add a separately verified user-verifying step-up factor bound to issuer+subject+application session with one-time server challenge, origin/RP validation, replay prevention, and server verification timestamp; or adopt an approved IdP with documented forced reauthentication support.

change_proposals.condition: PI and security review approve bounded application-session assurance instead of recent Google-account reauthentication
change_proposals.design: Retain signature/issuer/audience/azp/expiry/nonce/state validation and per-request ACL. Establish a server-controlled application session only at successful OIDC callback; maximum proposed 60 minutes capped by token expiry, revocation checked per request. Do not renew on page reload, st.user cookie reload or new tabs; do not use iat as auth_time. Treat auth_time as optional contextual evidence under the explicitly versioned new policy. No automatic fallback from current strict policy.
change_proposals.risk: Does not prove password/passkey entry within the last hour; an existing Google session may complete login. Session theft and administrator operations need risk acceptance and additional controls. Streamlit session_state alone is not sufficient for the proposed server session.
